title: Conditional κ = 7.51472114011902e-4: #307's fresh selections on the weighted gen5b word with #306's reorder stages
body:
Conditional κ = `375736057005951/(5·10^17)` = **7.51472114011902e-4**, +1.32 × 10⁻⁸ over [#306](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/306) (7.51458925311258e-4), +3.32 × 10⁻⁷ over [#305](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/305), +3.96 × 10⁻⁷ over [#275](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/275). The bit side binds below #233's complex supplier.

One self-contained package, `research/gen5bw-full-reorder/`, with its own workflow; branched from `main`, no existing file changed.

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package: all fourteen stages fresh (virtual, raw, bit with descent and targets, kernel, second descent, restore, sink, reorder, reorder2, scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite), package integrity unchanged (171 files), `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`, κ `375736057005951/500000000000000000`, ~7 minutes.

## Change

#306's package (eumemic's #305 composition on George Lydakis' weighted gen5b word, plus chafreaky's two reorder stages) with the kernel, second-descent, restoration and sink selections replaced by the ones re-derived on the weighted word in [#307](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/307), and the two reorder selections re-screened on that word with #306's own `discovery/build_reorder_selection.py`:

| stage | #306 | this package |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| collective kernel entries (450-restart packing) | 1,734, rank 2,196, φ −3,860 | **1,738**, rank **2,200**, φ **−3,880.5** |
| second constructed-frame descent | 87 gates | **90 gates** |
| early restorations / terminal sinks | 440 / 8 | 440 / 8 (R 15,424) |
| reorder (screened on this word) | 237 moves, φ −495.07 | 234 moves, φ −493.29 |
| reorder2 (re-screen) | 2 moves, φ −1.18 | 2 moves, φ −1.18 |
| κ | 7.51458925311258e-4 | **7.51472114011902e-4** |

Transforms, checkers, pins plumbing, bank tiling, the weighted virtual word and producer are byte-identical to #306; the six selection files, `expected/kernel-pins.json` and `MANIFEST.json` (171 files) are the changed inputs, every changed count a recomputed pin (913 charts, literal stock 1,229,655, 721,438 weighted ADDs). The gain over #306 is #307's packing search and descent on the actual kernel word, carried through the reorder stages (the weighted word's kernel census is identical to gen5b's).

## Verify

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r research/gen5bw-full-reorder/requirements.txt
```
```bash
python3 -B research/gen5bw-full-reorder/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5bw-full-reorder-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, new output directory outside the package; about 7 minutes; prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_RESTORE_SINK_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with the pinned κ (14 fresh stages, 14 omitted-stage controls).

## Scope and credits

Exactly #275/#305/#306's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; no Lean build. chafreaky (#306/#299: the reorder stage and its screen; #296 gen5b; #295 stages; kernel discovery), eumemic (#305 composition, #268), George Lydakis (#275 weighted matching), DreamingOfClouds, Dugongue, utcorvusvolat-dotcom, hcg890, Jacob Sussman, Evan McKinney and the retained lineage; the second descent and restart packing are from #291/#300/#307. Prepared by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance; Apache-2.0; lineage in `NOTICE.md`.
